Name: Uber Cask Mod
Author: Billeh007
Description: Uses Digus' [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2642]Custom Cask Mod[/url] along with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]JSON Assets[/url] to add an incredibly overpowered cask. This cask is crafted with 30 Iridium alongside a Prismatic Shard, and processes items 16x faster than a vanilla cask (4x faster than the radioactive cask from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8413]Advanced Casks Mod[/url]). It can also process items that normal casks can't, such as all dairy products, all mayo, honey, and the three tree tap resources.
